items.title: Marian McPartland — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] ...and Matt Watson is our sound engineer.

ctx.x: Today is January 3rd, nineteen hundred and ninety-seven, and we’re in the home of Marian McPartland in Port Washington, New York. This is an interview for the Smithsonian Institute Jazz Oral History Program. My name is James Williams, and Matt Watson is our sound engineer. All right, Marian, thank you very much for participating in this project, and for the record . . .
